purpose: Second campaign (2026-10-15, the last team API credits before they expired): the cells that would most reduce the theta uncertainty of served Claude models on mode C's chemistry axis (Multiaxis_ECI K=4 flagship, mode C), restricted to the rand-family benchmarks no public source will add, since Epoch's feeds already carry new scores for these models on other benchmarks; plus Claude Haiku 5.5, a model the 20261001 fit does not have.
operator: GPAI Policy Lab (Claude Code session for J. Andreoletti)
audit: Automated audit of every cell (2026-10-15): stop reasons, API refusals, refusals written in the answer, answers cut by max_tokens (16,000 tokens, thinking included), unparsed answers; no API error and no unparsed answer. Answers cut at max_tokens and refusals written in words are scored wrong.
history: Run at max effort with max_tokens 32,000 (streamed), LAB-Bench SeqQA left out: at high effort 36% of its answers were cut at 16,000 tokens and most still at 32,000 (user, 2026-10-15).

Stopped by the day's credit cap during its fourth epoch (2026-10-15 18:23 UTC); the five calls of epochs 1-2 interrupted in flight were completed on 2026-10-16, and the fourth epoch was finished the same day.

The 221 GPQA calls of epochs 0-2 cut at 32,000 tokens were run again at 64,000 tokens on 2026-10-16 (run --retry-truncated --keys): 103 finished, 113 were cut again, 5 refused; the superseded rows stay in the raw log's .superseded.jsonl.

request_params.other: provider defaults (no temperature, top_p, system prompt)

protocol.reference: RAND RR-A3797-1 (Dev et al. 2025), chapter 2, appendices B and D
protocol.solver: inspect_ai multiple_choice(), single-answer template, no CoT, no few-shot
protocol.parser: inspect_ai parse_answers() single-answer branch, commit ccdc03f
protocol.scoring: unparseable answers incorrect; a refused call earns the credit the model is expected to earn on that question (impute_missing: its own score on the question in other epochs, else a Rasch model, item difficulties from the other published runs); score = mean credit over questions and epochs; stderr = sd of per-question means / sqrt(n_items), imputation uncertainty not included. RAND's refusal = wrong is results.<bench>.score_refusals_wrong

notes.lab_bench: RAND implemented LAB-Bench itself without publishing its formatting: choices are the ideal answer and the distractors (no 'insufficient information' option); ProtocolQA puts the protocol above the question.
notes.mmlu_pro: RAND reports using an existing Inspect implementation of MMLU-Pro; the appendix-D template is used here, with up to ten letters.
